sections.name: build
sections.text:
[Build]
{soft kick on every beat, warm sub bass, a filtered synth rising, hard stop at the end}
positive_styles: soft kick drum on every beat
a filtered synth rises through the whole section
ends with a hard stop on the last beat, no tail

sections.name: drop
sections.text:
[Drop]
{full drums, bass and plucked synth from the first beat}
positive_styles: full and confident from the first beat
modern, clean, hopeful, a little mysterious

sections.name: breakdown
sections.text:
[Breakdown]
{light hi-hats and rim clicks, long bass notes, full drums return in the last second}
positive_styles: drums fall back to light hi-hats and rim clicks
full drums return in the last second

sections.name: groove
sections.text:
[Main groove]
{steady driving groove, no lead melody}
positive_styles: leave the middle and high register open

sections.name: groove-b
sections.text:
[Groove, new bass]
{new bass pattern, drums drop out for one second near the end, then return}
positive_styles: the same groove with a new bass pattern
drums drop out for one second near the end, then return
leave the middle and high register open

sections.name: peak
sections.text:
[Peak]
{fullest groove, strong accents on every beat}

sections.name: groove-c
sections.text:
[Groove, half-time turn]
{groove continues, two seconds at half time near the end, then back to full time}
positive_styles: near the end, two seconds at half time, then back to full time

sections.name: lift
positive_styles: the chords open up, brighter and wider, like a sunrise

sections.name: strip
sections.text:
[Strip back]
{soft pad and a single bass note only}
positive_styles: everything strips back to a soft pad and a single bass note

sections.name: chord
sections.text:
[Final chord]
{one warm wide A minor add 9 chord, held, fading to nothing}
positive_styles: one warm, wide A minor add 9 chord on a soft synth pad
held and slowly fading to nothing

plan_notes.v1: The brief's sections as written; context_adherence high on every chunk. Takes t1 and t2: tempo perfect, but the arrangement barely changes (kick on every beat throughout, no breakdown at 16 s, no strip-back at 68 s).
plan_notes.v2: Same sections and durations. Contrasting chunks get lower context_adherence, the arrangement is narrated with 'just ...', and absences are named (no kick in the breakdown, no drums in the strip-back and the final chord).
